blocks.text: O'zbekchada «Azizning mashinasi» deganda egasiga `-ning`, narsaga esa egalik qo'shimchasi (`-si`) qo'shiladi. Inglizchada egasiga **-'s** qo'shiladi, narsa esa o'zgarmaydi: Aziz**'s** car. Eng yoqimli tomoni — **tartib bir xil**: avval egasi, keyin narsa. Demak, **-'s** = o'zbekcha `-ning`. Odamlar haqida «the car of Aziz» deyilmaydi — faqat **Aziz's car**.

Qoida apostrofning o'rni bilan bog'liq. **Birlikdagi** ot — **-'s**: my friend**'s** car (bitta do'stimning). Oxiri `-s` bilan tugaydigan **ko'plikdagi** ot — faqat apostrof, **-s'**: my friends**'** car (bir nechta do'stimning), my parents**'** house. Oxiri `-s` siz ko'plik (children, men, women, people) — yana **-'s**: the children**'s** room. `-s` bilan tugaydigan ismlar: James**'s** flat (Britaniyada ko'pincha shunday), ba'zan James**'** flat. Og'zaki nutqda friend's va friends' bir xil eshitiladi — ma'noni kontekst ko'rsatadi.

items.text: My **parents'** flat is on the ground floor.
The **children's** toys are in the box.

blocks.text: -'s otsiz va ikki ega: It's Aziz's; Tom and Sarah's flat

**mine, yours** kabi (61-dars), **-'s** li so'z ham otsiz kela oladi: Whose is this? — It's **Aziz's** (Azizniki). Joy haqida ham shunday: at **Madina's** = Madinaning uyida («Madinanikida»), at the **doctor's** = shifokor qabulida, at the **baker's** = novvoyxonada. Ikki kishining **umumiy** narsasi bo'lsa, **-'s** faqat oxirgi ismga qo'shiladi: **Tom and Sarah's** flat — Tom bilan Saraning (bitta, umumiy) kvartirasi.

items.text: Is this scarf yours? — No, it's **Lola's**.

blocks.text: O'zbekcha `-ning` hamma narsaga qo'shiladi: «Azizning mashinasi», «filmning oxiri». Inglizchada esa **-'s** asosan **odam va hayvonlar** uchun ishlatiladi (shuningdek tashkilot, mamlakat va vaqt: today's news). **Narsa va joylar** uchun odatda **of** ishlatiladi, tartib esa teskari: **the end of the film** — filmning oxiri, **the name of the street** — ko'chaning nomi. Shuning uchun o'zbeklar ko'pincha «the film's end», «the street's name» deb xato qilishadi.

rows: the end **of** the film — filmning oxiri
the name **of** the street — ko'chaning nomi
the top **of** the page — sahifaning tepasi
the beginning **of** the month — oyning boshi
the back **of** the bus — avtobusning orqasi

items.text: We live at the **end of the street**.

blocks.text: 's — uch xil ma'no: is, has va egalik

Ismdan keyingi **'s** uch xil bo'lishi mumkin, farqini keyingi so'z ko'rsatadi. Keyin **ot** kelsa — egalik: Aziz**'s** car (Azizning mashinasi). Keyin sifat, joy yoki **-ing** kelsa — **is**: Aziz**'s** tired / at home / working (1-dars). Keyin **got** yoki V3 kelsa — **has**: Aziz**'s** got a car, Aziz**'s** finished. Va eslatma: oddiy ko'plikda apostrof **yo'q**: two book**s**, my parent**s** (egalik emas).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the car of my brother» → **my brother's car**; «Aziz car» → **Aziz's car** (`-'s` tushib qolmasin); «my parent's house» (ikkalasining uyi) → **my parents' house**; «the childrens' toys» → **the children's toys**; «the film's end» → **the end of the film**; «two book's» → **two books** (ko'plikda apostrof yo'q).
Eslab qolish: **-'s** = `-ning`, tartib ham o'zbekchadek — egasi oldin. Faqat narsaga qo'shimcha qo'shilmaydi: Azizning mashina**si** → Aziz's **car**. Narsa va joy uchun — **of**, tartib teskari.
Bog'lanish: Whose ...? va mine / yours — 61-dars (It's **mine** / It's **Aziz's**). Otlarning ko'plik shakli (`-s`, `-es`, children) — 66-dars. Qisqa shakllar it's, she's — 1-dars.

rows: my parents**'** house, the students**'** books

examples.title: Family and people: my **brother's** wife
examples.description: Oddiy otlar bilan ham **'s**: my **brother's** wife (akamning xotini), the **doctor's** advice (shifokorning maslahati), the **cat's** bowl.

examples.title: Dialogue: who's who at the wedding
examples.description: To'yda ikki mehmon kim kimligini aniqlayapti: **'s**, **s'**, ikki ega, otsiz **'s** va **of** aralash.

sentences.text: — Who's the woman next to **Lola's** mother?
— That's **Lola's** aunt — her **mother's** younger sister.
— And the tall man in the grey suit? Is he the **groom's** father?
sentences.translation: — Kulrang kostyumdagi baland bo'yli kishi-chi? **Kuyovning** otasimi?

sentences.text: — No, he's the **groom's** uncle; his father is at the next table.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, u **kuyovning** amakisi, otasi esa qo'shni stolda.

sentences.text: — Whose children are those, near the **musicians'** stage?
— They're **Dilnoza and Bekzod's** twins — they're five.
sentences.translation: — Ular **Dilnoza bilan Bekzodning** egizaklari, besh yoshda.

sentences.text: — What's the **name of this restaurant**? The food is great.
sentences.translation: — Bu **restoranning nomi** nima? Taomlari zo'r ekan.

sentences.translation: — Navro'z deb ataladi. Aslida bu **amakivachchamning** restorani.

sentences.text: — Really? Then let's have our next party at your **cousin's**!
— Good idea! But now let's dance — it's the **bride's** favourite song!
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr! Lekin hozir raqsga tushaylik — bu **kelinning** sevimli qo'shig'i!
